Doomsday combo: cast Doomsday to search out a 5-card library, then win the same turn (or the next upkeep) by drawing into and resolving Thassa's Oracle with an empty library, or by ticking Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. Dig and set up with Brainstorm/Ponder/Consider; power the pile with Dark Ritual, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Lotus Petal; Street Wraith and Edge of Autumn cycle to advance the pile draws. This is the deepest stack-sequencing deck in the pool: the entire kill is an instant-speed chain where card order in the pile, mana floating, and which draw/shuffle effect resolves first all matter. Protect the Doomsday resolution and the payoff with Force of Will, Daze, Flusterstorm, and Thoughtseize; hold up counters and fire on their end step when you can. Never cast Doomsday without a mapped-out, protected win that turn.

Painter artifact-combo/prison: the kill is Painter's Servant naming a color plus Grindstone, milling the opponent's whole library in one activation (Manifold Key / Voltaic Key untaps Grindstone to fire it early). Around that combo sits a fast-mana artifact prison — Ancient Tomb, Grim Monolith, Lotus Petal, Mox Opal power out Karn, the Great Creator and Tezzeret to lock the board and tutor pieces from the sideboard toolbox, with The One Ring and Urza's Saga for card advantage and bodies. Unlike the other decks in this pool the decision profile is more resource/prison sequencing than instant-speed stack war, but the Painter+Grindstone line and Karn-activated sideboard swaps still exercise combo-assembly and toolbox-search choices.
